reason: In packages/core/EventManager.ts:118-119, `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` is followed by an unguarded `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"`, which throws a TypeError whenever `evt.destinationCalendar` is null, undefined, or empty (the exact case the Google Meet fallback is meant to handle). While the other `[mainHostDestinationCalendar]` destructurings in the patch guard with `?.` or a truthiness check, this site introduces an unguarded undefined dereference.
